pairs.subject: release-pipeline
pairs.evidence: src/features/home/sub_releases/HomeReleases.tsx:41 The in-app release notes (the shipped-release cards) come from a hand-kept releases.json whose active version is 0.0.2 while the app ships 1.1.0 and CHANGELOG.md's newest cut is 0.4.0. Users get a release description that is neither derived from commit history nor tied to the version they are running.

techniques.evidence: src/data/releases.json:2 This is a third version record that no propagation tool writes and no drift gate checks. package.json:3, src-tauri/tauri.conf.json:4 and src-tauri/Cargo.toml:217 all say 1.1.0. No script under scripts/ or .github/ references releases.json.

src/data/releases.ts:4 Release items are authored by hand: structure in JSON, text in en.ts whats_new keys. Nothing compiles them from commits or from CHANGELOG.md. The file was last touched 2026-05-09 by an unrelated 'research:' commit, and CHANGELOG.md:481 shows a different version line ([0.4.0]).

pairs.registryProposal: changelog-generation could name the in-app 'What's New' surface as a second changelog output: it must be derived from the same compiled source as CHANGELOG.md, or it drifts into a separate version line, as it did here.
